name: Bajaj EV
description: Bajaj EV (Chetak e-scooter + e-3W) is the EV segment of listed parent Bajaj Auto Ltd (NSE: BAJAJ-AUTO), not a separately incorporated entity — figures are disclosed within Bajaj Auto's consolidated results.

stock.note: Reflects Bajaj Auto Ltd as a whole, not the EV segment specifically. Day range ₹12,090-₹12,470.

marketing_spend.derivation: Bajaj Auto doesn't split out EV marketing spend, and the EV business isn't in PMAR's top-10. Auto/EV brands typically spend ~2-4% of segment revenue on advertising during a land-grab phase; on EV revenue of ₹5,500 crore this models to ~₹110-220 crore for FY25, elevated by the Chetak 35-series launch and a 4,000+ touchpoint retail expansion.

business_updates.headline: Chetak crossed 700,000 cumulative sales; doubled e2W market share to ~22-23% in two years
₹5,633 crore share buyback at ₹12,000/share, plus ₹150/share dividend
New Chetak 'C-series' line-up with higher speeds and features
